subject: general
question: What is the purpose of the submarine cable project launched by the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) in 2025?

options.text: Increase internet speed in coastal areas

solution: The correct answer is __**Enhance long-term Indian Ocean observations**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The submarine cable project launched by the **Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)** in **2025** aims to enhance **long-term Indian Ocean observations**. • This project is part of a broader initiative to strengthen **marine research** and monitor **oceanographic parameters** such as temperature, salinity, sea level rise, and current patterns over extended periods. • The observations facilitated by this project will help in **predicting climate change patterns**, improving weather forecasting, and understanding the impact of environmental changes on the Indian Ocean ecosystem. • The submarine cables will be critical in relaying **real-time data** from remote ocean regions to research centers, enabling better analysis and response strategies. • This development aligns with global efforts to advance **sustainable ocean management** and strengthen India's role in international marine research collaborations.
